BiblicalUsage: Gav is the Aramaic word for the midst, the middle of a thing. The men who refuse the king's image shall be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace in Daniel 3:11, and the king warns them again in Daniel 3:15 that they shall be cast the same hour into the midst of the furnace. They were bound and cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace in Daniel 3:21, and the city of Jerusalem is accused of moving sedition within the same of old time in Ezra 4:15.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the midst of the furnace is where God's presence is proved. The three men were cast into the middle of the fire, and the fourth stood with them there. I hold that God does not always keep us out of the fire — sometimes He stands in it with us.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
